title: Design: Notes tab shows the note for a line marked No Charge
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin (a user with every setting, See Financial Data included).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide at 100% zoom.
  • Have Internal Work Orders turned on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a regular customer (not flagged), with one asset.
  • Have a new billable work order for the regular customer, not invoiced, with two lines: each with 1.0 h of labor and one stock part with a cost, made for this test.
  • Mark the second line No Charge with the category Warranty.
  • Open the attached pictures iwo-flow6-05-05-notes-and-audit-log.png, iwo-happy-34-34-notes-and-audit-log.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open the billable work order.
  2. Click the Notes tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The work order opens.

Step 2:

  • A read-only note by ShopView reads "Line '[title]' marked No Charge by [user]. Category Warranty, original work order [number], original line [number]. Line price $[price] removed; cost $[cost] and [hours] h kept. The work order stays billable."

Words in square brackets in a message stand for the value they name, such as the work order's number or the customer's name exactly as it is saved; every other word of the message must match exactly.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-12226 (Story 12, A no-charge line on a billable work order)

  • S12-R6: “Each action writes a system note on the work order and an Audit Log row (S2-R18): "Line '[title]' marked No Charge by [user]. Category [name], original work order [number], original line [number]. Line price $[price] removed; cost $[cost] and [hours] h kept. The work order stays billable."; "Category of line '[title]' changed from [a] to [b] by [user]."; "Line '[title]' marked Billable by [user]. Priced as a new line would be today: $[price]. Category [name] removed."”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
